# Peter Heals a Lame Man (Acts 3:6)

## Emotional Focus
When we feel weak and need Jesus’ power through His friends.

## Key KJV
“In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.” (Acts 3:6)

## Gentle Retelling
A man who could not walk sat at the temple gate. Peter said, “In the name of Jesus, rise up and walk!” The man jumped up and praised God.

## Coloring Prompt
Peter reaching out to a man who is standing up with joy at the temple gate.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus’ power works through His people to help others.”
